usable_window_post_purge.comment: PURGE+EMBARGO=21 is applied at the train|validation boundary (strips the last 21 of train) AND at the validation|frozen-eval boundary (strips the last 21 of validation). The frozen-eval fold is NOT purged on its trailing edge — it is the held-out final block. Usable validation post-purge = 25 - 21 = 4 days.

operator_visibility_field.comment: The optimization_results return dict must expose the usable-window day-counts so the operator sees the thin-window cost on every autotune cycle. This is the OPTUNA-4 Path B operator-visibility contract.

docstring_required_phrases.comment: The run_autotuner docstring must explicitly cite that the BHY (Benjamini-Hochberg-Yekutieli) selection-bias correction compensates for the thin usable validation window. The compensation argument is the load-bearing reason the 125-day window is operationally safe despite the ~4-day usable validation window.

named_constant.name: _OOS_USABLE_VALIDATION_DAYS_EXPECTED
named_constant.comment: Module-level pinned constant naming the expected usable validation day-count at the 125-day operator-data-budget. A drift in this value indicates either (a) the operator-data-budget changed or (b) PURGE/EMBARGO drifted; either case must be surfaced as an Amendment, not an audit slide-in.
